name: The session log reads on its own
prose: the black-box log under `<workspace>/.magentra/logs/` can be read without the transcript. Every line is valid JSON (long values are shortened inside the object and say by how much); only secrets are hidden, by their exact names and by the look of a key, so token counts survive; streamed deltas are folded into one line per block or second with their counts; a finished tool call carries its duration; a line names its tab and lands in that tab's own workspace log; the file name says it is UTC; and the renderer's state-sync frames before any engine runs are not reported as drops.
invariant: Every line of the session log is valid JSON that keeps what a reader needs — counts, durations, which tab — hides only secrets, and lands in its own workspace's log.
